title: Explicit natural coefficient recursion and adjunction transpose
statement: Fix a prime l, finite extension E/Q_l, finite field datum D, strict-system operations o, and primitive comparisons d as in [lem-sf-integral-basic-realization, def-sf-integral-system-operations]. Retain verbatim the Unary, Primitives, Reconstruction, Comparisons, coefficientMap, Equations, and direct compactification specifications of the existing expression-recursion specifications, relocated into a publicly reexported data module. For a finite typed expression e satisfying its geometric conditions [def-sf-integral-system-expression-domain], construct coefficientTransformation on the entire input-family category by composing the given unary/tensor natural transformations with the recursively whiskered child transformations. Its component at K is exactly the prescribed coefficientMap. Restrict to e.domain and define transposeComparison: realizationTarget -> realizationSource as the actual adjunction unit followed by L of coefficientTransformation. The adjunction hom-set equivalence proves R(transposeComparison_K) followed by the actual counit is coefficientMap_K. No invertibility or direct compactification equality is assumed in this construction.
